defaults.description: C-Kernel-Engine documentation for a CPU-native AI runtime, kernels, code generation, training, and inference on Linux systems.

index.html.title: C-Kernel-Engine: CPU-Native AI Runtime and Training Engine
index.html.description: C-Kernel-Engine is a CPU-native AI runtime and code generation system for training and inference in pure C, with auditable IR, kernel parity, and Linux-first deployment.

scaling.html.title: Scaling Philosophy for CPU-Only AI Systems
scaling.html.description: Why C-Kernel-Engine bets on Linux-only, CPU-only, server-grade hardware and open software instead of proprietary accelerator-heavy stacks.

version-history.html.title: Version History and Roadmap

spec-training-results.html.title: Spec Training Results and Run History
spec-training-results.html.description: Manifest-driven run history for C-Kernel-Engine specs, including best rungs, recent results, and the archive split between stable docs and raw run artifacts.

training-curriculum.html.description: A practical curriculum for growing C-Kernel-Engine from compiler-backed DSL training toward broader coding, tool use, and scientific reasoning.

v7-runbook.html.description: Operator runbook for C-Kernel-Engine v7 covering parity gates, training flow, canaries, probes, and cache-backed run artifacts.

v8-vision-encoder.html.description: Architecture page for how C-Kernel-Engine v8 lowers and runs the Qwen3-VL vision encoder, bridges the prefix, and continues generation in the decoder.

v8-mla-kimi.html.description: Implementation notes for C-Kernel-Engine v8 Multi-Head Latent Attention support, including Kimi/DeepSeek-style explicit decode cache lowering and kernels.

architecture-links.html.title: Architecture Links

kernel-tuning-methodology.html.title: Kernel Tuning Methodology
kernel-tuning-methodology.html.description: C-Kernel-Engine kernel tuning methodology for CPU-node performance work with VTune, Advisor roofline, perf, CK profile CSV, parity gates, and reproducible benchmark logs.

quickstart.html.title: Getting Started
quickstart.html.description: Quickstart guide for building and running C-Kernel-Engine, including the current v7 runtime path plus the v8 text-inference and Qwen3-VL multimodal bring-up surfaces.

contributing.html.title: Contributor Path: Start Small and Build Evidence
contributing.html.description: Five contribution levels for C-Kernel-Engine, from Linux compatibility and profiling through numerical fixtures, CPU kernels, compiler work, multimodal parity, and distributed execution.

pytorch-parity.html.title: PyTorch Parity and Numerical Validation
pytorch-parity.html.description: How C-Kernel-Engine validates kernel and training behavior against PyTorch with deterministic parity gates and numerical checks.

divergence-harness.html.title: Stitched Divergence Harness
divergence-harness.html.description: How C-Kernel-Engine compares generated C against llama.cpp, mtmd, and future PyTorch adapters by dumping matched tensors and finding the first divergent layer/op boundary.

deltanet-deep-dive.html.title: Gated DeltaNet Deep Dive
deltanet-deep-dive.html.description: Architecture and kernel notes for the Gated DeltaNet path in C-Kernel-Engine, including the Qwen3.5-style recurrent attention work.

test-report.html.title: Test Report
test-report.html.description: Automated C-Kernel-Engine nightly test report with current kernel, inference, architecture contract, and regression status.

v8-whisper-tiny.html.title: Whisper Tiny End-to-End | C-Kernel-Engine
v8-whisper-tiny.html.description: CKE v8 transcribes Whisper Tiny end to end from PCM16 WAV through generated FP32 encoder and decoder circuits: nightly audio gates, usage, evidence, and current limitations.

audio-kernels-deep-dive.html.title: Audio Kernels Deep Dive | C-Kernel-Engine
audio-kernels-deep-dive.html.description: Kernel-by-kernel walk of the Whisper audio frontend in C-Kernel-Engine: WAV decode, windowed-sinc resample, mixed-radix STFT power, log-Mel, Conv1D stem, and the token transpose, each with math, layout contracts, and PyTorch parity oracles.

memory-tetris.html.title: Memory Tetris: DRAM as a Tensor Cache over NVMe
memory-tetris.html.description: Research design for using a fixed DRAM arena as an explicit, lifetime-managed tensor cache over NVMe: arena-slot reuse, compute and I/O overlap, candidate Linux I/O paths, MoE expert residency, fail-closed safety contracts, X-Ray evidence, and hardware certification gates. Not implemented in the production runtime.

distributed-cpu.html.title: Distributed CPU: Zip Fusion Beyond Tensor Parallelism
distributed-cpu.html.description: Research design for whole-graph distributed CPU scheduling: the transformer block as a zipper, the reduction algebra that bounds synchronization payloads, a quantitative token-budget and sizing model (THEORETICAL), decode-versus-prefill bottlenecks, exact online-softmax merging at 1M context, heterogeneous proportional sharding, and a falsifiable validation ladder. Not implemented in the production runtime.

constraint-model.html.title: The CKE Constraint Model
constraint-model.html.description: Theory of Constraints as runtime math: per-region clocks for compute, cache, DRAM, network and storage; region time as max-plus-unhidden-sync; the exposed-transfer equation; the critical-path heterogeneous shard scheduler; CKU as the observable result; and the prediction-error control loop connecting Scaling Philosophy, CKU, Memory Tetris and Distributed Zip Fusion into one theory.

xray.html.title: X-Ray: Numerical Evidence and Divergence Attribution
xray.html.description: How CKE's X-Ray evidence system works: join-don't-instrument pipeline from call IR, kernel registry and oracle backends into schema-validated reports; checkpoint records; three-state verdicts and the honest scorecard; capture neutrality gates; failure classes; fix ownership; report taxonomy; and the IR visualizer X-Ray tab.

kernel-maps.html.title: Kernel Maps and Provider Selection
kernel-maps.html.description: How C-Kernel-Engine v8 selects which physical C kernel executes each logical op: 297 machine-checked kernel maps, a fail-closed resolver, the residual_save to memcpy case study, and the ratcheted migration scoreboard.

kernel-architecture.html.title: v8 Kernel Architecture
kernel-architecture.html.description: The v8 kernel registry organized by operation family: provider selection rules, equivalence groups, and the math behind MLA, DeltaNet, Mamba2, MoE routing, gated attention, and quantized GEMM providers.

architecture-variants.html.title: Architecture Variants
architecture-variants.html.description: What each contract-novel model family forced the v8 kernel registry to grow: Laguna gated GQA and split RoPE, Cohere2 parallel residual and logit scale, Instella gated MLA with FarSkip streams, Nemotron-H Mamba2 state.
